definition_en: kurtosis of the TSA difference signal (TSA minus shaft orders 1-2, mesh harmonics and their first sidebands)
definition_tr: TSA fark sinyalinin basıklığı (TSA eksi mil mertebeleri 1-2, kavrama harmonikleri ve ilk yan bantları)
basis: synthetic baseline (calc/hums/run_step310, 50 records); replaced by the engine test baselines of 3.11 per torque and speed bin (TBR)

definition_en: kurtosis of the TSA residual signal (TSA minus shaft orders 1-2 and mesh harmonics), normalised by the baseline residual variance
definition_tr: TSA artık sinyalinin basıklığı (TSA eksi mil mertebeleri 1-2 ve kavrama harmonikleri), temel artık varyansıyla normalize
target_fault: sun tooth crack, planet bore spall
basis: synthetic baseline (calc/hums/run_step310, 50 records); replaced by the engine test baselines of 3.11 per torque and speed bin (TBR)

definition_en: sum of the TSA amplitudes at mesh order 45 +- 1..6 over the TSA rms
definition_tr: kavrama mertebesi 45 +- 1..6 TSA genliklerinin toplamı bölü TSA rms
basis: synthetic baseline (calc/hums/run_step310, 50 records); replaced by the engine test baselines of 3.11 per torque and speed bin (TBR)

definition_en: envelope spectrum (7.4-9.4 kHz band) line at the planet bore defect frequency over the local median
definition_tr: zarf spektrumunda (7,4-9,4 kHz bandı) planet iç bilezik hata frekansındaki çizgi bölü yerel medyan
basis: synthetic baseline (calc/hums/run_step310, 50 records); replaced by the engine test baselines of 3.11 per torque and speed bin (TBR)
